sources.title: Union Station – entrances and Bay Street PATH

entrances.label: 200 Bay Street PATH access
entrances.description: West side of Bay Street, about 15 metres north of Front Street West; within Royal Bank Plaza. TTC lists elevator, escalator and stair access to PATH, but does not certify an end-to-end accessible route.

entrances.label: 181 Bay Street PATH access
entrances.description: East side of Bay Street, about 30 metres north of Front Street West; within Brookfield Place. TTC lists elevator, escalator and stair access to PATH, but does not certify an end-to-end accessible route.

entrances.label: Union Station Moat Entrance
entrances.description: TTC lists an accessible Moat Entrance near Front Street West and Bay Street. No precise indoor path polyline captured.

entrances.label: Front & Bay Entrance
entrances.description: TTC lists a sidewalk staircase on the south side of Front Street West, west of Bay Street, leading to concourse level.
